title: CallSession
description: State of a single call, owned by the Elixir voice_core. Conceptual data model for Phase 1; fields expand in later phases.

call_id.description: Stable identifier for the call (correlation ID across all services and logs).

session_id.description: Identifier for the agent/media session bound to this call.

direction.description: Call direction relative to the platform.

peer.description: Remote endpoint identifier (e.g. SIP extension). Optional.

agent_id.description: Agent handling the call, if assigned. Optional.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp, or null while active.
